verdict.rationale: Fellow's Developer API and Super Admin API let users pull transcripts, notes, action items and recordings via REST, and Super Admin API explicitly supports retrieving/exporting/deleting workspace data for compliance purposes; note content is exposed in 'Fellow Markdown' (GitHub-flavored markdown), a relatively open format. However there's no documented one-click 'export everything and delete my account' flow, no explicit open schema/spec (openapi.json probes 404), and no independent corroboration of real-world export completeness. missing for 10: a documented full-account export/portability workflow, a published open API schema (openapi.json), independent verification of export completeness.
